{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A wool-blend church skirt, knee-length, #3d2c25 (deep espresso brown), heavy felt fabric.
An embroidered linen blouse with a high neck, mid-length hem, #f5e6d3 (soft cream), crisp woven cotton-linen blend.
A cashmere cardigan draped open over the blouse, hip-length cut, #8c705e (warm taupe), soft knit wool blend.
Loafers in polished leather, ankle height, #1a1514 (rich black), smooth calfskin.
Pearl drop earrings, silver setting, #f0f0f0 (pure white luster), freshwater pearl and sterling silver.
This outfit respects the solemnity of church service through modest cuts and dark, grounded colors while maintaining comfort for a long day. The high neck blouse adheres to traditional decorum, allowing the cardigan to provide necessary warmth during the autumn morning without appearing overly heavy. Transitioning to a family lunch, the ensemble remains elegant yet relaxed enough for conversation with elders, balancing respect for religious tradition with personal style."}
